members.check: Far water meets distant land with a natural waterline; NO unnatural dark band across open water/sky. Distant-land silhouette may show mild tile-stepping (marginal, watch).
Smooth curved waterline with soft teal shallow blend; no tile-staircase, no white sliver.
Central shore segment: smooth waterline, no staircase/white sliver, no z-fight shimmer.
Bottom-right shore: smooth curved waterline; watch for screen-door dither stipple bleeding onto sand.
KNOWN FAIL: palm shadows render as screen-door dithered stipple blotches (diffuse dark-pixel cloud, no solid core) cast down-left. Should be crisp/short. Regression watch = does it get worse/better.
Pad edge is a clean straight diagonal, outline continuous; road/runway meets apron continuously; no cement tile-seam grid on the pad interior.
Cement pads/runway strip stay DARK (pad mean ~[12,15,14], not floodlit). Night-correct.
KNOWN FAIL: mech ground shadow renders as a light-grey triangular FAN ~2x BRIGHTER than the night terrain it sits on (fan ~[22,24,18] vs terrain ~[9,11,11]). Should darken, not lighten.
Dark water, lamp-lit causeway; perimeter-wall lamps sourced. No orphan glow.

HEADLINE FAIL: water outline snaps to terrain tile grid — one giant ~137-148px axis-aligned step, dead-vertical risers (x varies <=3px over 138px). Fix = subdivide/displace the water-edge isoline. Worst offender.
Right land-mass shore: repeated 90-degree tile steps; far-right kite has crisp straight angular edges meeting at hard vertices.
PASS (identified): isolated glow is a real lit building prop (bunker/turret + tree + soft ground pool), NOT a stray light. Watch it stays a legit prop.
Base peninsula waterline smooth; no staircase outline, sliver, or glow ring.
Coherent night base: warm building interiors, spotlight pools, runway/perimeter lights; sources visible and sanely placed.
Stippled/noisy white outline around tank-farm/pad = chain-link perimeter fence alpha-tested texture (legit asset, not a render bug). Reads slightly noisy under light pool.

Distant ridge-top base must be LIT (buildings, warm interiors, road, tower). On nifty this is correct; on deferred-sweep it regressed to PURE BLACK (max=0). Historically all-dark-at-angle-B symptom — key regression sentinel.
Near base: pools feathered, every glow sourced to a building/tower, no ghosts. Warm interiors (nifty) vs cooler/dimmer (deferred) = build tone difference.

SENTINEL: distant terrain below the horizon must render graded terrain + trees + soft fog skirt (nifty). On deferred-sweep it collapses to PURE BLACK below a razor-hard horizontal seam at screen-y~=323 (black-px count 153186 vs 553). Do not ship a build where this region goes black.
KNOWN class: pale blue-grey skirt/slab wraps the front corner (terrain feathers into a smooth extruded wall). Prominent purely due to corner framing; identical across builds. Not a new artifact.

HEADLINE FAIL: bright solid OPAQUE tan/cream 3D wedge (folded-plane mesh: lit top facet + shadowed bottom facet) floats in mid-air above the road between the two foreground guard towers — no support, no caster, empty terrain below. Root cause = searchlight light-cone rendering as opaque geometry.
Compound guard-tower searchlights show the same bug at smaller scale: a little opaque tan wedge at each housing instead of a translucent additive cone.
Ground pools around tower bases + along the road: soft/feathered radial falloff, no hard discs, no saturation clipping. Real searchlight beam (if framed) traces back to its tower.

Tree shadows must read as intentional directional long shadows from a low sun: PARALLEL (not fanning from a point), crisp/dark at trunk-contact, continuously softening toward the far end. No donut/hollow-center, no hard near/far seam, no ordered dither-step. Length ~2-3x tree height, consistent frame-wide. Currently PASS.
High-albedo snow is the harshest test: tree-base shadows landing on snow stay crisp at contact and fade smoothly; the contrast must NOT expose streak/banding/hard edge.

Snow renders as smooth wind-ripple texture with soft fog gradients — no stair-step luminance banding, no straight tile-seam lines. Scattered dark ovals = terrain microrelief/rocks (not casterless shadows).
HEADLINE FAIL: asphalt/cement meets terrain as a HARD, blocky, stairstepped tile boundary with only a 1px stochastic dither — no transition/blend. Matches user complaint 'doesn't blend'. Fix target.
Full interconnected runway grid (2 parallel horizontals + 1 vertical crossing); every terminus has threshold number + piano-key bar + end marker; no missing segments at ends or intersections.
